How many days of annual leave do I get?.answer: You get twenty days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly [Leave policy].
How many days of annual leave do I get?.context: Everyone gets twenty days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly.

Can I carry over unused leave?.answer: Yes, unused leave carries over for three months and then expires. More than five days needs manager approval [Leave policy].
Can I carry over unused leave?.context: Unused leave carries over for three months and then expires. Carry-over above five days needs approval from your manager.

Do I need a receipt for a twenty dollar.answer: Receipts are required for anything above twenty dollars; below that a card statement line is enough [Expenses policy].
Do I need a receipt for a twenty dollar.context: Receipts are required for anything above twenty dollars. Below that, a line in the monthly card statement is enough.

How quickly must I report a lost laptop?.answer: Within one hour, to the security team and your manager. After one hour it is treated as a data breach [Security policy].
How quickly must I report a lost laptop?.context: A lost or stolen device must be reported within one hour, to the security team and to your manager. After one hour the incident is treated as a data breach.
